task: T14 sequential Monte Carlo on the valuation and the pilot; significance (third pass)

pilot_model.reads_tier: ASSUMPTION (the plan says two consecutive reads without dates)
pilot_model.N_EFF_tier: ASSUMPTION: chosen so that 3 units a store-week equal 200,000 cubes a year; nothing in the repo ties the two

pre_registered_tests.i: Reject H0 (NPV <= 0) if P(NPV > 0) >= 0.95 under variant B. 90% credible interval against zero. Same rule reported for every other variant.
pre_registered_tests.ii: Segment lead significant only if P(ratio > 1) >= 0.95 and 90% interval excludes 1.
pre_registered_tests.iii: Separation: decide above if P(demand > midpoint) >= 0.9, below if <= 0.1; power target 0.80. Rule reads at weeks 8 and 13 with posterior threshold 0.5. Recommended store count criteria: week-13 power >= 0.80 for the decision pairs (1.5 vs 3.0, 1.5 vs 4.5), false-scale at 1.5 <= 0.10, false-stop at 4.5 <= 0.10.

variant_definitions.A_record05_structure: All inputs with priors, except binder and flavour at 0, citric acid at 2.10 g, no cannibalisation; before excise, pre-tax
variant_definitions.B_headline_full_prior: All inputs with priors, incl. binder and flavour, citric acid 2.10 to 3.70 g, cannibalisation; before excise, pre-tax (pre-registered headline)
variant_definitions.C_tax_no_relief_before_excise: B with 20 percent tax on positive annual operating profit, no loss relief, no depreciation shield
variant_definitions.A2_record05_structure_after_excise: A with the ex-factory share scaled by 0.535628 / 0.60 (can net-to-listing chain ratio, record 75), pre-tax
variant_definitions.B2_full_prior_after_excise_pretax: B on the after-excise basis, pre-tax
variant_definitions.D_record75_lead_basis: B on the after-excise basis with 20 percent tax, losses credited in the year, year-0 outlay (one year of fixed cost) depreciated straight line over 5 years (record 75 structure)
variant_definitions.D_cf_standalone_carry_forward: D with a stand-alone entity: depreciation deducted, losses carried forward (5 years)
variant_definitions.B_wide_repeat_prior: B with repeat ~ Beta(mean 0.283, sd 0.10), allowing repeat below the 15 percent stop floor
variant_definitions.D_wide_repeat_prior: D with the same wide repeat prior
variant_definitions.B_no_price_volume_correlation: B with rho = 0 between shelf price and first-purchase volume

fixed_demand.note: NPV at a fixed true steady demand with every other input drawn from its prior (price and volume independent). Cubes a year = 52 * N_EFF * demand. N_EFF is an ASSUMPTION.

ratio_A_25_34_over_35_44.source: rework/screen/segment_stat_results.json (record 47; sampling error only on the odds ratio)

ii_segment_lead.pre_registered_rule: Significant only if P(ratio > 1) >= 0.95 and the 90% interval excludes 1.

evolution_over_many_pilots.note: R pilots of 20 stores per truth, 2,000 particles each, own random stream (seed + 71). P(NPV > 0 | data) is the weight-averaged exact conditional P(NPV > 0 | volume) of the prior (static inputs independent of demand). Mean, SE of the mean and 10th, 50th, 90th percentile across pilots, weeks 1 to 13. The truth is the start-of-pilot level.

value_of_waiting_week13_minus_week8_by_c.conventions: start_of_pilot_level: every rule scored on the start level (second pass). decision_time_level: a rule scored on the national level at its own decision week. common_week13_level: every rule scored on the week-13 level.

operating_characteristics.recommendation_note: The criterion applies to the decision pairs (1.5 against 3.0 and 1.5 against 4.5), a halving of demand. The pair around the rule line (3.0 against 4.5) does not reach 80 percent power at any tested store count, so no tested count meets an all-pairs criterion. Powers are estimated from R_OC pilots per cell (binomial SE about 0.02 near 0.8).

limits: Priors are ASSUMPTIONS or PROXY values from records 05, 06 and 70. No market data.

The 20 percent tax rate is tier S (primary-origin page, Revenue Department page 6044, last updated 23 November 2020, read 20 October 2026 through a page summary, so not P). The structure (loss relief, depreciation shield, carry-forward) is an ASSUMPTION; three structures are reported.

N_EFF (store-equivalents behind 200,000 cubes) is an ASSUMPTION; every break-even in units a store-week is conditional on it. It is back-solved so that 3 units a store-week equal 200,000 cubes; as context it is 8.0 percent of the about 15,945 7-Eleven stores of submission/04 (read as Thailand-only by inference), which is not a derivation.

Basis mixing: variants B, C, B_wide and B_rho0 subtract the after-excise can contribution (THB 4.13) from a before-excise cube contribution, which flatters the cannibalised cases (record 75, section 11). The consistent cannibalisation versions are B2 and D (both after excise); P(NPV above 0) is lower there (B2 0.267, D 0.262). Variants A and A2 have no cannibalisation term, so the mixing does not arise in them. The pre-registered headline B is therefore the more favourable reading and still fails the test.
Variant A fixes citric acid at 2.10 g, binder and flavour at zero and cannibalisation at zero; the other variants give those three inputs priors.

Value of waiting (Bayes rule, week 13 minus week 8), pooled over 40,000 simulated truths: the sign depends on the scoring convention (start-of-pilot level, level at the decision week, common week-13 level). The largest absolute value over the three bases and three conventions is THB 4,909; as a share of the value of the demand read it is at most 2.6 percent (A), 1.3 percent (B) and 3.8 percent (D). Acting five weeks later also costs the discount factor 0.9909 at the prior mean rate (about THB 9,117 per THB 1 million of NPV); the delayed rows apply it to the week-13 rule.

Separation power is scored against the start-of-pilot label. For the halving pair (1.5 against 3.0) the power changes by at most 0.04 between week 4 and week 13 at 15 to 40 stores (Monte Carlo SE about 0.02), so weeks after about 4 add little. For 3.0 against 4.5 the change is -0.03 at 30 stores and -0.06 at 40 stores. Re-scoring each pair against the level at the read week instead of the start label changes the power by at most 0.00 (separation_by_scoring_convention), so the fall is not a labelling effect: the level itself drifts (sd of the log level 0.073 by week 13), which moves some pilots toward the midpoint. It depends on the assumed weekly drift of 0.02 (ASSUMPTION); at 0.005 the week-13 power for 3.0 against 4.5 at 40 stores is 0.89.

Store count: the recommendation is at halving resolution (1.5 against 3.0 units). Powers are estimated from 300 pilots per cell (binomial SE about 0.02 near 0.8). The largest absolute z between neighbouring store counts in the comparisons made (15 against 10, 20 against 10, 20 against 15, 30 against 20, 40 against 20) is 4.1; counts whose powers differ by less than about 0.05 are not statistically distinguishable.
Demand model: one common national level plus a store offset with sd sigma_store/sqrt(S). Store heterogeneity beyond that is not modelled.

The pilot informs demand only in this model. It does not inform fixed cost, price realisation, cost lines or the cannibalisation share, so the value of the pilot here is a lower bound for any learning on those.
In the pilot world the static inputs are independent of demand; the prior predictive keeps the price and volume correlation. The copula-retained break-even is reported.
Repeat rule uses Beta(1,1) in the operating characteristics; contribution rule uses the prior probability only.
Read weeks 8 and 13 are an ASSUMPTION; the two reads come from one cumulative posterior and are correlated (phi reported).
